_doc: Newsletter packs: finished, on-brand product newsletters the generator clones-and-rewrites (mirrors products/registry.json). templatePath = the coded email template in the HubSpot Design Manager; its source of truth is renderers/email/templates/product-newsletter.html (upload via `hs cms upload`). Slots are filled by overriding content.widgets[name] (see renderers/email/HUBSPOT-INTEGRATION.md). heroAsset references assets/library.json by key (rendered from Figma + hosted in HubSpot File Manager at generate time). Validated by tools/validate_newsletters.py.
